text: kAlgeria’s startup ecosystem in 2026 is state-led, expanding, and still early in private-capital depth. The country has built a broad policy and support infrastructure around formal startup labels, public investment vehicles and nationwide incubation, but venture funding remains highly concentrated in a few standout companies and modest relative to larger African and MENA markets.
